title: AMD touts open source as a key advantage over Nvidia
excerpt: AMD executives said the company's open-source software is a key advantage in its competition against Nvidia, enhancing AI chip development.
content_html:
AMD executives say the chip company has a key advantage over Nvidia: being more open

By Rosalie Chan

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

AMD says it has a major advantage in the AI chip race against Nvidia: being more open.

AMD has long promoted this strategy through its open-source ROCm software, used to program AI chips. Since ROCm is available as open source, it's free for anyone to use, download, or modify. On the company's earnings call on Tuesday, AMD CEO Lisa Su said this software is at an "inflection point," with open-source contributions up 10 times in the past year.

Two AMD executives spoke with Business Insider in July, prior to earnings, about how making some of the company's major software and hardware products open-source gives the company a leg up over companies such as Nvidia and Qualcomm. In particular, they see this approach as an advantage over CUDA, Nvidia's software that runs on its AI chips and is widely considered a moat.

There's a reason for this, the executives say: it helps AMD cheaply tap into the skills and contributions of thousands of engineers to develop its software faster in a red-hot AI race.

"The power of the open source community is just unprecedented," said Kirk Saban, corporate vice president of product, software, and solutions. "You can tap into all of those developers, and they're essentially doing free development work for us. They're upstreaming code into our code base, and you're leveraging the best and brightest minds in the industry."

AMD says its latest chips are the best for AI agents, largely because developers can improve the software through open-source contributions, said Salil Raje, senior vice president of AMD's adaptive and embedded computing group. He called open source "a central pillar in our strategy."

"We believe in getting the ecosystem to work with us, and we will use the same kind of strategy in the physical AI and robotic space," Raje said. "In fact, the reason agentic AI works for our platform better than maybe the competitors' platform is because our software is out in the open now."

Chip companies, including AMD, have seen some volatility in the stock market lately, with a massive sell-off in late July.

While they have rebounded, AMD's stock was down 9% in late trading on Tuesday after it reported earnings. Revenue came in at $11.5 billion, beating analysts' expectations. Capital expenditures nearly tripled to $808 million, compared to the previous year.

As companies seek out more compute to power their AI systems, they've increasingly turned to AMD as an alternative to Nvidia. AMD's stock is up about 193% in the past year, while Nvidia has gained roughly 20%.

作者：Rosalie Chan 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

AMD 表示，它在与 Nvidia 的 AI 芯片竞争中拥有一个主要优势：更加开放。

AMD 长期以来一直通过其用于人工智能芯片编程的开源 ROCm 软件来推动这一战略。 由于 ROCm 是开源的，任何人都可以免费使用、下载或修改。 在周二的公司财报电话会议上，AMD 首席执行官 Lisa Su 表示，该软件正处于“拐点”，开源贡献在过去一年中增长了 10 倍。

7 月份，AMD 的两位高管在财报发布前接受了 Business Insider 采访，谈论了该公司的一些主要软件和硬件产品开源如何让该公司比英伟达和高通等公司更具优势。 特别是，他们认为这种方法比 CUDA 更有优势，CUDA 是 Nvidia 在其 AI 芯片上运行的软件，被广泛认为是护城河。

高管们表示，这样做是有原因的：它可以帮助 AMD 以低廉的成本利用数千名工程师的技能和贡献，在白热化的人工智能竞赛中更快地开发软件。

“开源社区的力量是前所未有的，”公司产品、软件和解决方案副总裁 Kirk Saban 说。 “你可以利用所有这些开发人员，他们本质上是在为我们做免费的开发工作。 他们将代码上游到我们的代码库中，而您正在利用业内最优秀、最聪明的人才。”

AMD 自适应和嵌入式计算部门高级副总裁 Salil Raje 表示，AMD 表示，其最新芯片最适合人工智能代理，这主要是因为开发人员可以通过开源贡献来改进软件。 他称开源是“我们战略的核心支柱”。

Raje 表示：“我们相信生态系统能够与我们合作，我们将在物理人工智能和机器人领域使用同样的策略。” “事实上，代理人工智能在我们的平台上比竞争对手的平台更有效的原因是因为我们的软件现在是开放的。”

包括 AMD 在内的芯片公司最近股市出现了一些波动，7 月底出现了大规模抛售。

尽管有所反弹，但 AMD 公布财报后，其股价在周二尾盘交易中下跌了 9%。 收入达 115 亿美元，超出分析师预期。 与上一年相比，资本支出几乎增加了两倍，达到 8.08 亿美元。

随着公司寻求更多的计算来为其人工智能系统提供动力，他们越来越多地转向 AMD 作为 Nvidia 的替代品。 AMD 的股价在过去一年上涨了约 193%，而 Nvidia 的股价上涨了约 20%。
